info.title: Pipedream Utils Universal API

get.summary: Helper Functions - CSV File To Objects
get.description: Converts a /tmp CSV file to objects in Pipedream Utils.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: The path to the file saved to the `/tmp` directory (e.g. `/tmp/example.csv`). [See the documentation](https://pipedream.com/docs/workflows/steps/code/nodejs/working-with-files/#the-tmp-directory).

schema.description: The path to the file saved to the `/tmp` directory (e.g. `/tmp/example.csv`). [See the documentation](https://pipedream.com/docs/workflows/steps/code/nodejs/working-with-files/#the-tmp-directory).

parameters.name: hasHeaders
parameters.description: Set to `true` if the first row of the CSV contains headers. If there are headers in the file, the keys of the objects will be the header values. If there are no headers, each object will be an array of values.

schema.description: Set to `true` if the first row of the CSV contains headers. If there are headers in the file, the keys of the objects will be the header values. If there are no headers, each object will be an array of values.

parameters.name: skipEmptyLines
parameters.description: Set to `true` to skip empty lines in the file.

schema.description: Set to `true` to skip empty lines in the file.

parameters.name: skipRecordsWithEmptyValues
parameters.description: Set to `true` to skip records with empty values. Don't generate records for lines containing empty values, empty Buffer or equals to `null` and `undefined` if their value was casted.

schema.description: Set to `true` to skip records with empty values. Don't generate records for lines containing empty values, empty Buffer or equals to `null` and `undefined` if their value was casted.

parameters.name: skipRecordsWithError
parameters.description: Set to `true` to skip records with errors. Tolerates parsing errors. It skips the records containing an error inside and directly go process the next record.

schema.description: Set to `true` to skip records with errors. Tolerates parsing errors. It skips the records containing an error inside and directly go process the next record.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
